name: Bloody Bone Necklaces
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Kin'weelay turns the Bloodscalp conflict into a private struggle.

sections.title: Trophies of War
sections.body: Kin'weelay came to Grom'gol Base Camp to help Nimboya, yet he has purposes of his own. The Bloodscalp trolls to the north are enemies of the Darkspears. Kin'weelay believes trophies taken from fallen foes grant spiritual power over them. So he asks travelers to hunt Bloodscalp warriors and take the bloody bone necklaces they wear.

sections.title: Leeching the Spirits
sections.body: Kin'weelay plans to boil the bone necklaces and leech them down to paste. Through this ritual, he hopes to wither and weaken the lingering spirits of slain Bloodscalp.

faq.q: Who asks for the bone necklaces?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay asks for the bone necklaces at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale. He came to aid Nimboya, yet pursues his own spiritual vendetta.

faq.q: Why does Kin'weelay want trophies from the Bloodscalp tribe?
faq.answer: The Bloodscalps are bitter enemies of the Darkspear tribe. Kin'weelay believes trophies from slain foes grant power over them, giving the Darkspears a way to assert dominance over their rivals.
The Bloodscalp trolls dwell north of Grom'gol Base Camp, across northern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What comes next after this hunt?
faq.answer: After the hunt, Kin'weelay sends you on to Split Bone Necklace.

angles.text: As a Darkspear, hunting the Bloodscalp means gaining power over an enemy tribe.
Kin'weelay came to Grom'gol Base Camp to aid Nimboya. He uses his time there to hunt the Bloodscalp to the north.

attribution: In-game quest text: Bloody Bone Necklaces
